purpose: Re-account the exact frozen ART-025/EXP-06R R1 primary trade set as a funded daily portfolio without changing trade selection, direction, threshold, entry, exit, horizon, or primary costs.

mathematical_contract.active_session: A_i(t)=1 iff entry_session_i <= t <= exit_session_i because entry is at open and exit is at close.
mathematical_contract.raw_commitment: K_t = sum_i A_i(t)*(1+c_i), where c_i is frozen total round-trip cost rate. This uses schedule/sign cost class only and never realized prices.
mathematical_contract.normalization: K_star=max_t K_t; lambda=1/K_star. Each trade initial absolute notional n_i=lambda. Starting capital C_0=1.
mathematical_contract.shares: For asset: q_i=n_i/P_i_entry. Sign is stored separately. For matched SPY: q_i_SPY=n_i/B_i_entry.
mathematical_contract.long_entry: free_cash -= n_i + 0.5*n_i*c_i + exit_cost_reserve; long asset opens at n_i; exit_cost_reserve=0.5*n_i*c_i.
mathematical_contract.short_entry: free_cash -= n_i + 0.5*n_i*c_i + exit_cost_reserve; short sale proceeds n_i plus own collateral n_i are restricted; short liability opens at n_i; proceeds cannot finance another position.
mathematical_contract.short_mtm: L_i(t)=q_i*P_i_close(t); restricted short assets remain 2*n_i until close, absent borrow/rebate/margin cashflows.
mathematical_contract.end_of_day_nav: NAV_t = free_cash_t + sum_active_long[V_i(t)+exit_reserve_i] + sum_active_short[2*n_i+exit_reserve_i-L_i(t)], after close exits and exit-cost consumption.
mathematical_contract.long_exit: At frozen adjusted close, free_cash += q_i*P_i_exit; exit reserve is consumed as the second half of frozen total cost.
mathematical_contract.short_exit: At frozen adjusted close, free_cash += 2*n_i - q_i*P_i_exit; exit reserve is consumed as the second half of frozen total cost.
mathematical_contract.benchmark: Matched-SPY pseudo-book uses the same sign, dates, n_i=lambda, overlap schedule, and conservative short-capital treatment, but no transaction cost, to preserve legacy market-adjusted semantics.
mathematical_contract.daily_active_pnl: a_t = (NAV_t-NAV_{t-1}) - (NAV_SPY_t-NAV_SPY_{t-1}), with both pre-sample NAVs equal to 1.
mathematical_contract.gross_mtm_exposure: G_t = sum_active_long V_i(t) + sum_active_short L_i(t), reported over initial capital C_0; it may exceed 100% due price moves and is never used to rescale capital ex post.
mathematical_contract.net_mtm_exposure: N_t = sum_active_long V_i(t) - sum_active_short L_i(t), reported over C_0.
mathematical_contract.committed_capital_utilization: U_t=lambda*K_t; max_t U_t = 1 by construction before financing-failure checks.
mathematical_contract.gross_turnover: Primary explicit turnover statistic is sum of absolute execution market values divided by initial capital. Entry-only turnover is sum n_i/C_0. No ambiguous annualized turnover label.
mathematical_contract.drawdown: H_t=max(C_0,NAV_1,...,NAV_t); DD_t=NAV_t/H_t-1; MDD=min_t DD_t. Starting capital is a real high-water mark.
mathematical_contract.time_under_water: Maximum consecutive exchange sessions with NAV below the prior high-water mark, starting from C_0.
mathematical_contract.daily_return: r_t=NAV_t/NAV_{t-1}-1 only when both NAVs are positive.
mathematical_contract.hac_sharpe: Secondary descriptive: SR_HAC=sqrt(252)*mean(r)/sqrt(gamma_0+2*sum_{k=1}^{10}(1-k/11)*gamma_k). Fixed lag 10 is tied to the frozen holding horizon.
mathematical_contract.sortino: Secondary descriptive daily Sortino uses MAR=0 and downside deviation sqrt(mean(min(r_t,0)^2)); no naive IID significance claim.
mathematical_contract.bootstrap: Primary uncertainty layer uses Politis-Romano stationary bootstrap on additive daily active PnL a_t, 20,000 replications, mean block length 10, seed 20260812. Pre-frozen block-length sensitivities are 5 and 20. Percentile 95% CI. No promotion threshold is created.
mathematical_contract.double_cost_diagnostic: Same frozen positions and primary lambda; subtract one additional copy of frozen costs. No re-normalization and no new NAV path is promoted. It is diagnostic only.

short_financing_policy.cash_gate: If free_cash < -1e-12 on any session, fail NO_LEVERAGE_CASH_GATE. Do not increase starting capital using realized prices.
short_financing_policy.insolvency_gate: If NAV <= 0, portfolio risk metrics requiring positive wealth are invalid and the run fails funded-portfolio feasibility.

reconciliation_gates: Exactly 34 trades, 21 long and 13 short, with frozen R1 identities and no extra/missing rows.
Entry/exit dates and endpoint prices match authoritative ART-025 data exactly at source precision.
Per-trade gross/net/market-adjusted return reconstruction absolute error <= 1e-8.
Terminal portfolio identity residual absolute error <= 1e-10.
Matched-SPY terminal identity residual absolute error <= 1e-10.
No interpolation of missing intermediate prices; missing required price fails closed.
No duplicate trade_id or non-positive/non-finite price.
Price adjustment semantics and source snapshot/hash are fixed before portfolio output is read.
Primary book and matched-SPY book pass no-hidden-leverage cash gates.

tier3_uncertainty: stationary-bootstrap CI for mean active daily PnL and terminal active PnL

prohibitions: No capital normalization using realized MTM prices or PnL.
No deletion of losing trades or concurrency cap chosen after outcomes.
No new sizing rule, threshold, direction, horizon, entry, exit, or signal.
No naive sqrt(252) Sharpe presented as primary evidence under overlap.
No historical borrow fee, margin rate, rebate, or L2 execution input invented.
No relabeling of legacy max_additive_drawdown_opportunity as portfolio MDD.
No W2-A output may reclassify H2 or replace C0_NO_TRADE as historical frozen champion.

references.source: Lo, The Statistics of Sharpe Ratios
Politis & White, Automatic Block-Length Selection for the Dependent Bootstrap

freeze_rule: This draft may be frozen only byte-identically after human/adversarial review. Any substantive change requires rerunning all synthetic cases and a new version.
